# Calculator ~ by Ganit Technology

> Universal privacy-first calculator platform. 45+ calculators across 18 categories.
> Offline-first PWA. No backend, no tracking, no API keys.

## About

Calculator by Ganit Technology is a comprehensive, browser-based calculator platform built and maintained by Ganit Technology, a project of the Dhurta Organisation. The platform is available at https://ganit.dhurta.org.

## JavaScript API

The platform exposes a complete API at `window.Ganit` (alias: `window.OmniCalc`).

### Core

```js
window.Ganit.calculate("2 + 2 * sin(30)")
// => { result: 3, formatted: "3", meta: { ... } }

window.Ganit.evaluate("(100 * 1.18) - 50")
// => { result: 68, formatted: "68", meta: { ... } }
```

### Scientific

```js
window.Ganit.scientific.sin(30, 'DEG')   // => 0.5
window.Ganit.scientific.cos(0, 'RAD')    // => 1
window.Ganit.scientific.log(1000)        // => 3
window.Ganit.scientific.factorial(10)    // => 3628800
```

### Financial

```js
window.Ganit.financial.loan({ principal: 100000, annualRate: 7.5, months: 240 })
// => { monthlyPayment, totalInterest, totalPaid, ... }

window.Ganit.financial.compound({ principal: 1000, rate: 10, years: 5, n: 12 })
// => { amount, interest, ... }
```

### Health

```js
window.Ganit.health.bmi({ weight: 70, height: 175, unit: 'metric' })
// => { bmi: 22.9, category: 'Normal weight', ... }
```

### Percentage

```js
window.Ganit.percentage.of(15, 200)         // => 30
window.Ganit.percentage.change(80, 100)     // => 25 (% increase)
window.Ganit.percentage.discount(500, 20)   // => { discounted: 400, saved: 100 }
```

### Format

```js
window.Ganit.format.number(1234567.89, 'en-IN') // => "12,34,567.89"
window.Ganit.format.currency(99.99, 'USD')       // => "$99.99"
```

## Web Component

```html
<script type="module" src="https://ganit.dhurta.org/js/web-component.js"></script>
<ganit-calc type="basic"></ganit-calc>
<ganit-calc type="scientific"></ganit-calc>
<ganit-calc type="currency" from="USD" to="EUR"></ganit-calc>
```

## URL API

Navigation is hash-based. All routes:

- `#/basic` — Standard arithmetic
- `#/scientific` — Scientific (trig, log, exp)
- `#/engineering` — Engineering (hex/dec/oct/bin, unit converter)
- `#/financial/loan` — Loan amortization
- `#/financial/compound` — Compound interest
- `#/financial/roi` — ROI / CAGR
- `#/financial/retirement` — Retirement planner
- `#/financial/inflation` — Inflation adjuster
- `#/health/bmi` — Body Mass Index
- `#/health/bmr` — BMR / TDEE
- `#/health/bodyfat` — Body fat percentage
- `#/health/water` — Water intake
- `#/percentage` — 9 percentage tools
- `#/area` — 2D/3D shapes (area & volume)
- `#/age` — Age calculator with planetary ages
- `#/currency` — 80+ currency converter (user-editable rates)
- `#/programmer/base-converter` — HEX/DEC/OCT/BIN
- `#/programmer/hash` — SHA-256, SHA-1, MD5 (Web Crypto)
- `#/programmer/base64` — Base64 encode/decode
- `#/programmer/ascii` — ASCII/Unicode table
- `#/programmer/uuid` — UUID v4 generator
- `#/programmer/url` — URL encode/decode
- `#/programmer/morse` — Morse code
- `#/programmer/color` — HEX/RGB/HSL/CMYK color converter
- `#/equation/linear` — Linear equation solver
- `#/equation/quadratic` — Quadratic (with complex roots)
- `#/equation/cubic` — Cubic equation
- `#/equation/system2` — 2×2 linear system
- `#/equation/system3` — 3×3 linear system
- `#/matrix` — Matrix operations (add, mul, det, inverse, etc.)
- `#/statistics/descriptive` — Descriptive statistics
- `#/statistics/regression` — Linear regression
- `#/statistics/distributions` — Normal, binomial, Poisson
- `#/physics/kinematics` — SUVAT equations
- `#/physics/forces` — Force, work, energy, power
- `#/physics/gas` — Ideal gas law
- `#/physics/chemistry` — pH, molar mass, radioactive decay
- `#/physics/projectile` — Projectile motion
- `#/construction/concrete` — Concrete volume
- `#/construction/tiles` — Tiles & flooring
- `#/construction/paint` — Paint coverage
- `#/construction/stairs` — Staircase builder
- `#/construction/bricks` — Brick/block calculator
- `#/construction/electrical` — Ohm's law
- `#/construction/roof` — Roof pitch
- `#/datetime/diff` — Date difference
- `#/datetime/add` — Add/subtract from date
- `#/datetime/timezone` — Timezone converter (IANA)
- `#/datetime/countdown` — Countdown timer
- `#/datetime/unix` — Unix timestamp
- `#/datetime/week` — Week number, quarter, day-of-year
- `#/graph` — Multi-function 2D graphing
- `#/about` — About this application
- `#/privacy` — Privacy policy

## Privacy Guarantee

This application sends **zero data** to any server. There are no analytics, no ads, no cookies beyond localStorage for user preferences and IndexedDB for local history. Currency/crypto rates are user-editable only; there are no live API calls.

## Technology

- Frontend: Vanilla ES Modules (no framework)
- Math: Shunting-yard algorithm (no eval)
- Storage: IndexedDB + localStorage
- Offline: Service Worker (cache-first)
- PWA: Full installable progressive web app
- Web Components: `<ganit-calc>` custom element
- i18n: 24 locales with RTL support
- Themes: 15+ CSS custom property themes
